design: Towering powerfully built armored urban guard wearing a unique full-face gunmetal biomask: wide flat triangular forehead, narrow recessed eye slits, squared projecting lower jaw with four vent slots, no human mouth. Thick black dreadlocks in a fan behind helmet. Full blackened scale armor with broad vertical chest band, double layered angular shoulder plates, bronze rim fastenings, three long dark skirt panels, heavy greaves with exposed claw tips. Both hands loosely rest on the top of an upright heavy hooked polearm close to chest; reserved standing pose.
